Steps.Title: Add coffee powder
Steps.Hint: Coffee powder is in the brown bag. Tap the bag to tip it into the cloth sock.

Steps.Title: Pour hot water
Steps.Hint: Pour hot water from the kettle into the kopi pot. Tap the kettle.

Steps.Title: Brew, then lift the sock
Steps.Hint: Dip the sock into the hot water to brew, then lift it out. Tap the sock filter.

Steps.Title: Place the cup
Steps.Hint: Set the glass cup in front of the kopi pot. Tap the cup.

Steps.Title: Add condensed milk
Steps.Hint: Pour condensed milk into the bottom of the cup. Tap the condensed milk tin.

Steps.Title: Add sugar
Steps.Hint: Add a spoon of sugar into the cup. Tap the sugar bowl.

Steps.Title: Pour the kopi
Steps.Hint: Pour the brewed kopi from the pot into the cup. Tap the kopi pot.

Steps.Title: Stir and serve
Steps.Hint: Stir until the milk mixes in, then serve. Tap the spoon.
